thread:
maria-sales: Heads-up — OnboardPad is evaluating a swap from Swivel API to Redwood for a 2‑week POC. They care about prompt parity, token billing differences, and the security questionnaire. Can @josh-se look at mapping and @anya-sec on SQ/KMS asks? :wave:

josh-se: On it. Do we have the exact Swivel endpoints they use and sample payloads? Also need expected RPS and latency targets.

lee-customer: hi all, thanks for jumping. POC target window is Apr 6–20. Primary calls: Swivel /v1/generate, /v1/embed, and a session handshake that posts session_id + conv_state. Example payload we send now:

```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "prompt": "Summarize...",
  "model": "swivel-13b",
  "session_id": "abc-123",
  "temperature": 0.2
}
```

We also rely on token-level billing and some vendor-specific tokenization for prompts.

josh-se: thanks — quick mapping proposal: Swivel /v1/generate -> Redwood /v1/completions; field mappings: `session_id` -> `conversationId`, `model` -> `model` (we'll provide closest equivalent), `prompt` -> `input`. We can add a small shim to normalize headers. Example shim mapping snippet:

```
// adaptor example
swivelReq = JSON.parse(req.body)
redwoodReq = {
  input: swivelReq.prompt,
  model: mapModel(swivelReq.model),
  conversationId: swivelReq.session_id || null
}
```

We should run their prompt set through our tokenizer diff harness. I can prep that if they share ~1000 prompt/examples.

maria-sales: pricing question from them: they want to understand per-token billing differences and any hidden delta (e.g., Swivel charges for KV/session storage). Can we offer clear docs and a brief POC pricing note?

sam-ae: For the POC we usually provide $10k in credits and waive overage for the first 30 days; also can offer a short Reserved trial if they need stable p50 latency. I'll draft a POC pricing note: includes hosted per-token, embeddings per-unit, plus optional Dedicated trial pricing.

olivia-legal: They included an initial security questionnaire with KMS and data residency calls out. @anya-sec can we confirm support matrix for Hosted vs Private (KMS, audit logs, contract language)?

anya-sec: Quick answers: Hosted: envelope encryption + customer can bring keys via our KMS integration for Dedicated/Private; Private supports customer-managed KMS/HSM and on-prem audit logs. For the SQ we need their SOC2 scope, IP allowlist, and any specific retention requirements. Blocking items: if they require Hosted with customer-managed KMS and full in‑scope SOC evidence we may need Private deployment.

lee-customer: also a technical ask — some of our prompts depend on Swivel's tokenizer. Will outputs be identical? We use prompt templating that assumes exact token boundaries.

josh-se: short answer — we don't guarantee byte-for-byte tokenization parity across different runtimes. However, we have an emulation shim and test harness: we can run diffs against their golden set and flag deltas. Acceptance criteria proposal: <=1% semantic drift measured on their eval prompts + manual QA on top 100 high-sensitivity prompts. We can also pin a model variant that minimizes deltas.

maria-sales: blockers checklist I'm tracking: 1) legal signoff (target Apr 2), 2) network allowlist/IPs from infra, 3) sample prompt set & golden outputs by Mar 30, 4) POC pricing note and credits, 5) decision on Hosted vs Dedicated (KMS). Can owners confirm?

sam-ae: I'll own pricing note and credits.

josh-se: I'll own adaptor shim + diff harness run — need prompt set and sample responses by Mar 30.

anya-sec: I'll answer SQ and confirm KMS support; will follow up with a short answers doc and open items list.

lee-customer: thanks — I'll send the prompt set today and the SQ. Also confirming Wed 11am PST sync to review adaptor mapping and acceptance criteria.

maria-sales: perfect — see you Wed. adding a quick deploy-bot note for firewall/IPs.

deploy-bot: Note added: please provide IP ranges for allowlist requests to infra@redwood.com.

maria-sales: :thumbsup:
